evidence_layers.rationale: Orogenic gold travels along crustal-scale shears and second-order faults. Proximity to mapped structures is the strongest pathway proxy.
references: Chitipa airborne geophysics interpretation (GSD) — link layer when licensed

evidence_layers.rationale: Fault intersections and high fracture density mark dilation zones where fluids focus.
DEM-derived lineaments are an UNVERIFIED structural proxy — use only with mapped structures, never alone.
Competency contrasts (e.g. mafic/granite contacts, BIF) act as chemical + rheological traps.
Au (+As pathfinder) soil/stream anomalies are direct evidence of mineralising system.
Sentinel-2 B4/B2 iron-oxide ratio marks oxidised alteration; DERIVED, vegetation-masked.
Sentinel-2 B11/B12 clay/hydroxyl ratio marks argillic alteration; DERIVED, vegetation-masked.

preservation: Low-relief areas with moderate cover; avoid deep weathering zones where signal is masked
source: Greenstone / mafic-ultramafic volcanics, BIF horizons as Fe source
pathway: Crustal shears + second-order faults, lineament intersections
trap: Competency contrasts, fold hinges, dilational jogs; potassic/iron-oxide alteration halo
